blocks.text: Recommended for Vendor invoice processing (India, company code 1000): RPA-led automation. Rule-based RPA is the best fit for 15 of the 16 steps open to automation, mainly because no judgment is needed and the input is structured data.

items: Of 20 steps people do today: Rule-based RPA for 15, AI-assisted automation for 1, 4 stay with people. 1 step is already done by a system.
Readiness: Ready to automate. No major change is expected, and the rules are stable enough to build on.
Up to 20,900 hands-on hours a year could be automated.
Priority is not settled yet. The value could lie on either side of 1,000 hours a year. The build effort depends on facts not yet known.

blocks.caption: Pain points

rows.text: All invoices are keyed manually into SAP.
The Excel tracker is double work, kept only for status visibility.
Average nine days from receipt to posting, above the SOP target of five working days.
Early payment discounts are almost never captured.
Slow posting puts the 45-day MSE payment rule at risk.
Approval evidence in email is inconsistent and was raised by internal audit.
No agreed turnaround for buyers to resolve variances.
Invoices often arrive before the goods receipt is posted.
Password-protected PDFs need a call to the vendor.
GL coding for non-PO invoices depends on past postings and has no fixed rule.
A 2024 OCR pilot failed on line-item accuracy; the team re-checked everything.

rows.text: Save the invoice PDF to the vendor folder in SharePoint and add a row to the AP tracker.
AP shared mailbox (Microsoft 365), SharePoint library "AP Invoices", AP tracker (Excel on SharePoint)
Scan paper invoices received at the Pune office so they arrive in the shared mailbox as PDF.
Confirm legal name and GSTIN, vendor GSTIN, invoice number and date, PO number, HSN/SAC and tax breakup.
Missing or incorrect mandatory field; Invoice addressed to another legal entity; Password-protected or unreadable PDF
Confirm in SAP that the vendor exists, is not blocked and the GSTIN matches; compare bank details with the vendor master.
Bank details differ from vendor master; GSTIN mismatch
Email the vendor with template AP-T01 stating the reason, and set tracker status Returned.
AP shared mailbox (Microsoft 365), AP tracker (Excel on SharePoint)
Search SAP (FBL1N) and the AP tracker by vendor and invoice number.
SAP S/4HANA, AP tracker (Excel on SharePoint)
Raise a ServiceNow request to Vendor Master Data and hold the invoice when bank details differ.
Enter the invoice in MIRO with reference to the PO; SAP proposes PO lines and goods receipts.
Email the invoice to the approver(s) required by the DoA; remind at 2 and escalate at 5 working days.
Delegation of authority for non-PO invoices; Approval follow-up
Approver reviews the invoice and replies approved or rejected by email.
Delegation of authority for non-PO invoices
SAP compares invoice, PO and GR for price and quantity against tolerances.
Price tolerance; No over-invoicing of quantity
Park invoice and request goods receipt
Park the invoice in MIR7, email the requester or stores to post the GR, remind at 3 and escalate at 7 working days.
SAP S/4HANA, AP shared mailbox (Microsoft 365), AP tracker (Excel on SharePoint)
Requester or stores posts the goods receipt in MIGO, or confirms the goods were not received.
Save the approval email as PDF, then enter the invoice in FB60 with GL account and cost centre.
Park the invoice and email the buyer with the PO and invoice; set tracker status Variance.
SAP S/4HANA, AP shared mailbox (Microsoft 365), AP tracker (Excel on SharePoint)
Price variance beyond tolerance; Quantity exceeds goods received
Post the invoice in SAP and attach the PDF through Services for Object.
AP Team Lead reviews invoices of INR 5,00,000 or more (invoice, PO or approval, GL coding, tax) before posting.
Buyer decides whether the PO or the invoice is wrong, based on contract and what was agreed.
Record the SAP document number and set tracker status Posted.
Buyer amends the PO in ME22N when the PO price is wrong.
Request credit note or revised invoice
Buyer asks the vendor for a credit note or revised invoice when the vendor charged wrongly.

blocks.caption: Pain points

rows.text: All invoices are keyed manually into SAP.
The Excel tracker is double work, kept only for status visibility.
Average nine days from receipt to posting, above the SOP target of five working days.
Early payment discounts are almost never captured.
Slow posting puts the 45-day MSE payment rule at risk.
Approval evidence in email is inconsistent and was raised by internal audit.
No agreed turnaround for buyers to resolve variances.
Invoices often arrive before the goods receipt is posted.
Password-protected PDFs need a call to the vendor.
GL coding for non-PO invoices depends on past postings and has no fixed rule.
A 2024 OCR pilot failed on line-item accuracy; the team re-checked everything.

Given invoice not addressed to Kaveri Industrial Components Ltd. or GSTINs do not match, when the solution carries out "Check mandatory fields", then return to vendor for a corrected invoice.

Given bank details on the invoice differ from the vendor master, when the solution carries out "Validate vendor", then AP does not process; Vendor Master Data verifies by call-back to the registered number.
Given same vendor, same invoice number and same gross amount in the same financial year, when the solution carries out "Check for duplicates", then do not post; mark duplicate and inform vendor.

Given gross amount up to INR 2,00,000 / above 2,00,000 up to 10,00,000 / above 10,00,000, when the solution carries out "Request non-PO approval", then cost Centre Owner / plus Department Head / plus Finance Controller.

Given no approval reply for a non-PO invoice, when the solution carries out "Request non-PO approval", then remind after 2 working days; escalate to the Finance Controller's office after 5 working days.
Given the solution reaches "Approve non-PO invoice", when cost Centre Owner / DoA approver decides it, then the case continues only with that recorded outcome.

Given no GR for the invoiced quantity, when the solution carries out "Park invoice and request goods receipt", then remind requester after 3 working days; escalate to AP Team Lead after 7 working days.
Given the solution reaches "Review high-value invoice", when AP Team Lead decides it, then the case continues only with that recorded outcome.
Given the solution reaches "Investigate variance", when buyer (Procurement) decides it, then the case continues only with that recorded outcome.

Given same vendor, invoice number and gross amount already recorded, when step 6 is carried out, then the solution applies the stated handling: do not post; confirm with vendor; mark duplicate; and routes the case to the AP Clerk.

Given no GR exists for the invoiced quantity, when step 8 is carried out, then the solution applies the stated handling: park; request GR; remind at 3, escalate at 7 working days; and routes the case to the Requester / Stores.

Given invoice price exceeds PO price beyond tolerance, when step 11 is carried out, then the solution applies the stated handling: park; refer to buyer; and routes the case to the Buyer (Procurement).

Given invoiced quantity is more than the GR quantity, when step 11 is carried out, then the solution applies the stated handling: park and ask stores for the difference; and routes the case to the Requester / Stores.
Given no reply from approver, when step 9 is carried out, then the solution applies the stated handling: remind at 2 and escalate at 5 working days; and routes the case to the Finance Controller.
Given PDF cannot be opened, when step 3 is carried out, then the solution applies the stated handling: request a readable copy from the vendor; and routes the case to the Vendor.
